doc: Seeds file of the M3 typed-sorts sidecar (format: the docstrings of holon.sorts.extracted, rule E3, and holon.sorts.grammar, writer labels). Authored in the blind rerun from the tooling code and docstrings only. It states no vocabulary: no term, digest or lexical seed, and no writer-label rule (every writer set takes the documented fallback label), so nothing refines a variable but the transitions document itself (types, flow, the affine rules and comparisons): nothing is guessed.
